request: Owner: «эти иконки довольно странные, убери иконки, это показатель ИИ-слопа», then «Так я вроде сказал про ребрендинг иконок, давай делать, давай сделаем их в стиле той мозаики» — the Florentine pietra dura of the Instagram highlight covers (design/social/instagram/highlights/pietra-dura). Then: «только на гайдах и визе» — the icons live on the guide and visa pages only; the home page and the cabinet keep cells without icons. Then: «оставь только мозаичную структуру и сами элементы без кружков, а то кружки ассоциируются с ИИ-слопом» — the objects alone, in the same inlaid stone, without the disc and ring.
model: Higgsfield gpt_image_2_6, quality high, 1k, 1:1, transparent background (the model of the Instagram covers, so the stone matches)
template: The same {object} as in the first reference, made in the Florentine pietra dura technique: polished coloured stone pieces (ivory marble with grey veins, honey-gold Siena marble, terracotta jasper, a few deep green stone accents) fitted together with fine dark brown seams between every piece, and a fine dark brown stone outline around the whole object so it stands out on a light cream page. Show ONLY the object, isolated on a transparent background: no disc, no round frame, no ring, no circle, no background shape at all. The object fills about 85% of the square, centred. Flat, even, soft light, no glare, no cast shadow. No text, no letters, no numbers.
processing: crop to alpha (>4 %), centred on a transparent square plus 6 px; master WebP q92 in design/illustrations/source/mosaic/; site WebP q86 with alpha at 112 and 224 px (shown at 44–52 px).
